lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is broader at the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch, with a higher density/tighter spacing in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1 and 2 are abbreviated; posterior lines 11 and 12 are truncated. Line 10 exhibits a distinct mid-segment break.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast white circular spots is located on the posterior haunch, situated between the final vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible on the upper section of the hind limb haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Two emerging conical horn buds, angled approximately 45 degrees posteriorly from the frontal bone plane.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.5:1 ratio of terminal tip distance relative to the width of the individual horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots on the cheek area; one white spot on the bridge of the nose; a white transverse band on the proximal right forelimb; dark pigmentation on distal limbs (socks).
